environment.execution: isolated development environment, not user Windows repository

notes: Point-in-time reconstruction is bitemporal: provider truth is selected using both knowledge time and event-validity time.
Later provider corrections never rewrite frozen historical decision evidence as if they had been known earlier.
A post-decision correction may require controlled re-analysis but does not, by itself, determine whether the original analysis was good or bad.
The isolated suite count must not be represented as the user repository count until a consolidated installer is verified on the user machine.
scope: Provider Corrections, Revisions & Temporal Truth Governance
